additions: (12) an upgrade or rebuilding of an existing electric line and associated facilities with a capacity of less than 100 kilovolts to a high-voltage transmission line with a capacity of 115 kilovolts, provided that at least 80 percent of the length of the upgraded or rebuilt high-voltage transmission line in Minnesota is located along an existing electric line right-of-way
This section is effective the day following final enactment and applies to any applicable project for which upgrading or rebuilding has begun on or after that date.
